name: e1-below-control
airframe: Fighter1, Multirole1, SmallFighter1, trainer, VTOLTrainer1, EW1, FastBomber1, Darkreach
note: THE CONTROL FOR E1: oblique-6's geometry, unchanged - the same 6 deg diamond centred ON the horizon - with the same Control/BelowAlignSuppress swept ABBA. The v0.85 suppression keys on alignFracH, horizon-referenced belowness, which is ~0 here, so this knob must have NO effect on this card. PASS: the two arms are indistinguishable - terminalOffDeg, rollYawOpposedPct and stickFlipRateR separate by less than the mirror-pair spread compare-runs.py reports for this card. FAIL: any arm separation at all; that is a regression, the suppression reaching a geometry it was never supposed to touch, and it also invalidates whatever e1-below-suppress measured. Fly it in the same session as e1-below-suppress and on the SAME EIGHT KEYS in the same order - a control on a different roster controls for nothing. FLEET since v0.94: per-aircraft arm state, so every lane runs its own independent ABBA (8 lanes x repeat 8 = 64 runs, same wall clock as one lane). AIRFRAME: the eight fixed-wing keys that clear the v0.92 envelope gate (1.10x Vstall .. 0.95x Vmax) at this card's 250 m/s. CAS1 (0.95x Vmax = 195.3), COIN (134.6) and all three rotorcraft would be refused pre-spawn and are left out rather than shipped as guaranteed refusal lines.
